login_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
login_account_locked: Account temporarily locked after too many failures. Try again later.
login_totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login_totp_intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_recovery_intro: Enter one of your single-use recovery codes.
setup_intro: Create the administrator account for this instance. You only need to do this once.
setup_token_help: Printed in the server logs at startup, on the line "Atlas setup token: …".
setup_invalid_name: Invalid name (1-100 characters, no control characters).
invite_intro: You've been invited to join this Atlas. Choose your password to activate your account.
invite_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid (already used or expired).
invite_invalid_name: Invalid name (1-100 characters, no control characters).
share_expired_message: This link's validity period is over.
share_expired_hint: The document owner can generate a new link.
share_revoked_hint: If you need it, ask the owner for a new link.
share_invalid_message: This link does not match any shared document.
share_invalid_hint: The URL may be incomplete or badly copied.
share_unavailable_message: The link verification service is temporarily unreachable.
oauth_intro: {client} is asking to access this Atlas on your behalf.
oauth_redirect: Once you agree, you will be sent back to {host}.
oauth_scopes_hint: Untick what you don't want to grant:
oauth_scope_read: Read your documents, their history and the activity
oauth_scope_write: Create, edit, move and delete documents
oauth_error_client: This application could not be verified: {reason}.
oauth_error_session: Your session expired or the request is no longer valid. Start the connection again from the application.
prompt_weekly_description: What moved in the Atlas, what is going stale and the contradictions to settle, in one recap.
prompt_triage_description: Go through the document pairs that may contradict each other, and record a verdict for each.
prompt_new_doc_description: Write a document from one of the Atlas templates (decision, meeting, spec…).
prompt_new_doc_body:
Create the document "{subject}" from the "{template}" template below. Fill each section with what you know from our conversation, leave blank what you don't know and ask me for what is missing. Save it with create_doc, where AGENTS.md says.

{skeleton}
